title: [finding] `references/lanes/engine.md:15` states `packages/lint` ⇒ `domain:devx` with no exception — a third text carrying the lane-table mis-read #16993 measured
body:
Filed by the `os-dev` executor of #16993 while implementing it (session `session_01HxLw5aKDPR5RJgyUR7Exkd`, branch `claude/issue-16993-lane-table-lint-split-anchor`), measured on `origin/main` `c43bac704`, 2026-09-09. Outside that card's file surface (the `SKILL.md` lane table, its anchoring rule, `core-rules.md`), so filed rather than folded in. No label set; the skills lane self-triages its findings.

## The measurement

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/engine.md:15` (the engine seat's 红线 list, ceiling 32/32) reads, verbatim:

```text
- `content/docs/**` 与 `packages/lint` ⇒ `domain:devx`。
```

No qualification, no pointer. `grep -rn "packages/lint" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/` returns exactly two lines: this one and `devx.md:7` — and `devx.md:12` goes on to say 「SUBJECT 例外与 spec 三面切分在 SKILL.md 域车道表」, so the devx job description at least announces that a split exists; the engine one does not.

## The contract it contradicts

Before #16993's PR the lane table itself carried the split as a trailing clause on two rows (「与 `domain:spec` 相交的面按是否围着 spec 契约转切分」 on the `domain:devx` row; 「及围着 spec 契约转的工具链;一般开发工具面留 `devx`」 on the `domain:spec` row). After that PR the statement sits beside the anchoring rule, verbatim:

```text
- 唯一例外 `packages/lint` 等与 spec 相交的 devx 面:围着 spec 契约转的归 `domain:spec`,余留 devx。
```

Either way, `engine.md:15` asserts the unqualified half — the exact sentence #16993 measured two execution seats deriving from the table's package list and acting on. An engine seat that reads its own job description (which it must) is handed that reading ready-made.

## Admission class

(b): it contradicts the declared routing contract quoted above. It is also the same trap #16993 was admitted for — a text that leads a seat to a wrong routing conclusion — carried by a third document. ⛔ Not measured: whether an engine seat has actually mis-routed on it; the finding is the text, not a sighting.

## Shape of the fix, if graded queueable — ⛔ not proposed here

Two candidates, triage's to choose: reduce the line to a pointer at the anchoring rule's exception (in place at 32/32, 120-byte cap), or drop `packages/lint` from the engine red-line list altogether, leaving `content/docs/**` (the red line's purpose is 「not ours」, and 「not ours」 is still true — but stated as 「devx's」 it is half wrong). ⛔ Not a third copy of the split; #16993's ruling is 「One statement, two pointers」.

## Dedup reading

REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=open&labels=domain:skills&per_page=100` → 25 cards; positive control #16993 present; no card names `engine.md` or `lanes/engine`. Local grep of the same tree as above.
